prognoza.naslov: Odbijena formulacija (EN): Three separate headlines - a church honor, a culture-editor appointment, a union protest - each link to the same Blic cable-theft story at near-identical similarity scores [F38][F39][F40], which looks less like three confirmed shared events and more like the link organelle favoring one generic cluster. Meanwhile the city's only live witnesses stay the citizen sensors [F3] and the Parking Servis feed [F4], whose Pionirski park figure moved from 171 to 355 displayed spaces [F5] without any clock attached, at 04:47 on a Wednesday [F1]. Danas's cloudy-rain headline [F7], Beta's football result [F9], RTS's election piece [F14], and Euronews's blood-drive notice [F16] all carry scope I cannot anchor to any instrument without their own event-location and time checks.
